Aloe | Multiple Engineering & Research roles | ONSITE Vancouver, BC, Canada | Full-time

Aloe is the epistemic intelligence lab building AI we can trust with humanity's most important applications. We work on research and products that bring introspection to AI and critical thinking to machines. Our Agent Models are designed for decision-making in the real world – AI that understands what it does and doesn't know, reasons about its limitations, and directs its own learning to self-improve.

Please read the job description and include in your outreach why you fit not just the role but also our culture. We strive to be Level 5 humans, co-creating a deliberately developmental atmosphere.

https://aloe.inc/careers

The future we’re building for:

- Commoditize access to expertise, capability, and AI’s economic promise for both businesses and end-users

- Make new discoveries, products, and experiences possible at speeds unbound from human performance

- Defend against negligent or malicious use of AI with internal governance and risk evaluation at the foundation

- Invert the extraction economy with AI that respects human cognition instead of exploiting it
